system.description:
You can perceive points of weakness within an object and use The Force to telekinetically press on one of those points, shattering the object.

[Telekinetic]

Time: Standard Action

Targets: One unattended object within 12 squares of you and in your line of sight.

Make a Use the Force check. The result of the check determines the result, if any:

DC EFFECT
20 The object takes 4d6 points of damage.
25 The object takes 6d6 points of damage.
30 The object takes 8d6 points of damage.
35 The object takes 10d6 points of damage.

Special: You may spend a Force Point when you activate this Force Power to increase the damage dealt to the object by +2d6.
